q02.label: perfect
q02.proof_summary: The candidate is the exact abstract transition of the reference. The mutant changes a doubly-linked node's second lane rather than its first; every observable divergence violates BundleStep.

q03.label: complete
q03.proof_summary: CandidateSFExact fixes every reference output equation. Any observable q03 mutant divergence is at X[6] and violates that exact equation; the extra X[7]=old_X[7] conjunct only strengthens rejection.

q04.label: sound
q04.proof_summary: An 8-bit sum is congruent modulo 16 to the mathematical byte sum. The mutant's low-nibble result has the same congruence and is accepted.
